description: OpenAgents on your phone: ask anything and get an answer in seconds, start coding tasks that run in our cloud, and connect your own computer when you want to. No computer is needed.
whatToTest: Build 1030: Grid only, based on the 1028 starting point. The home screen has Aethyr stars and a nebula behind Coming soon, with Enter the Grid near the bottom. Grid takes over the screen directly, with its camera behind the player and no fly-in. Hold and repeatedly tap the controls: no text highlighting, lookup menus, or browser zoom should appear. Try moving, looking, jumping, rotating, switching apps, Home, and re-entering Grid. There is no chat, account, or background chat sync in this build. Internal testing only.

review.notes:
No account, demo login, or computer is needed to review the app.

1. On first launch the app opens on a chat. Type a question such as "What is OpenAgents?" and send it. The answer comes from our hosted assistant and streams in. There is no sign-in: the app makes an account on the device.
2. New chats run on our servers. A coding request starts a cloud computer for it, covered by a free allowance.
3. Connecting your own computer is optional: scan the code the desktop app shows (Settings > Connect a computer). Nothing else in the app needs a computer.

Contact: chris@openagents.com
